principles: Prefer additive prompt and documentation guidance over behavior-changing CLI defaults.
Always pair compact status examples with a full-output fallback for evidence-sensitive work.
Keep package templates, Claude mirrors, and Codex mirrors mechanically consistent.
Verify with executable smokes rather than relying on prompt prose.
drivers: Routine repeated story_get/checklist_get output can add avoidable context cost.
Reviewer and DONE behavior must not lose access to full evidence.

options.name: A: Shared prompt-registry guidance plus targeted docs/examples
pros: Centralizes guidance inside the load-bearing prompt slice used by key Lattice agents.
Keeps command defaults and gate semantics unchanged.
Regression tests can check one canonical guidance phrase across templates and mirrors.
cons: Adds a small amount of text to templates, so savings depend on agents actually using compact commands.

options.name: B: Change story_get/checklist_get defaults to slim output
pros: Would reduce output size automatically for all callers.
cons: Breaks compatibility for existing scripts and agents that rely on full output.
Risks evidence-sensitive conclusions from incomplete data.
Contradicts the B-f495 non-goal to keep defaults unchanged.

options.name: C: Only update documentation, leave agent prompts unchanged
cons: Does not affect the prompt surfaces most likely to repeat status commands.
Regression coverage would not protect agent behavior guidance from drifting.

chosen: A: Shared prompt-registry guidance plus targeted docs/examples
rationale: Option A implements the accepted plan with the smallest behavior risk: compact queries become recommended for routine orientation, full output remains explicit for evidence-sensitive work, and existing CLI defaults stay stable.

preMortem.scenario: Agents overuse slim output and miss detailed evidence.
preMortem.trigger: Prompt wording says compact queries without the full-output fallback.
preMortem.consequence: A reviewer could make an evidence-sensitive conclusion from summarized data.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the full-output fallback in the shared snippet and assert it in prompt-token-cost-smoke.

preMortem.scenario: Claude/Codex mirrors drift from package templates.
preMortem.trigger: Only package templates are edited without synchronizing mirrors.
preMortem.mitigation: Update mirrors and run prompt-registry-smoke plus verify_codex.

preMortem.scenario: Smoke tests run stale dist code.
preMortem.trigger: Running dist smoke before npm build after TypeScript edits.
preMortem.mitigation: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build before built smoke tasks.
